page.overview:
What is Blue Suede Shoes?

Blue Suede Shoes is a song originally written and recorded by in 1955. Elvis Presley recorded a version in 1956 and the song became a signature tune for both musicians. A version by The Beatles (in the medley: Rip It Up/Shake, Rattle and Roll/Blue Suede Shoes), dating from the Let it Be session, is found on Anthology 3.

John Lennon: Vocal, Rhythm Guitar (1965 Epiphone Casino)

Paul McCartney: Bass (1963 Hofner 500/1)

George Harrison: Lead Guitar (1968 Fender Telecaster)
